79c112ac12d89cc4c2881a3b23c05b5eb05fbc98.summary: A BlackBerry Research & Intelligence Team write-up on emulating a macOS ARM64 kernel under QEMU on a Linux host, to reach an interactive shell for debugging and vulnerability research by pen-testers and researchers. It describes a methodology and project log. It names no threat actor, malware family, campaign, incident, sector, country or CVE, so it is not a threat report.

798de1d888a708ba10b2739e34a9f7ca980bb2cd.summary: News report from The Register dated 14 Sep 2011 on Trojan.Mebromi, a rootkit that reflashes a computer's BIOS chip to add malicious code. The code alters the master boot record and checks the BIOS on each boot, so it survives antivirus removal. Per Webroot's researcher, it only targets Award BIOS ROMs and was first documented by Qihoo 360, mainly infecting machines in China. The report also mentions earlier BIOS-modifying malware (CIH/Chernobyl in the late 1990s, IceLord in 2007). Much of the page is unrelated news teasers.

792c873b87d42b65631625e67338e7a1f53e94a2.summary: Anomali Threat Research describes China-based cryptomining actor Rocke changing its command-and-control in 2019, moving from Pastebin to self-hosted subdomains and then to DNS TXT records with a DNS-over-HTTPS fallback. Its LSD malware gained exploitation of ActiveMQ via CVE-2016-3088, uses SSH and Redis brute forcing and stored SSH keys, and keeps persistence through cron jobs and systemd. The report warns the group could switch to more damaging payloads such as ransomware or a RAT.

798281d4a0716e29d71f447aaf819f6b222ae8ea.summary: A CrowdStrike Falcon OverWatch blog post dated 17 September 2021 describes four defense evasion techniques seen in 2021 intrusions: signed binary proxy execution via Rundll32, DLL search order hijacking, DLL injection, and BITS jobs. It links two intrusions to the eCrime actor WIZARD SPIDER, which used Cobalt Strike and attempted Ryuk ransomware deployment. It also describes a likely China-nexus adversary that tried to install PlugX. The post says OverWatch identified more than 60 defense evasion techniques and subtechniques in interactive intrusions during 2021.
